faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. Starter and Studio include a 14-day free trial, no credit card required. You can also explore the demo workspace at any time.

faq.question: Can I cancel or switch plans?
faq.answer: Yes. Upgrades apply straight away. Downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period. Scale runs on an annual contract.

faq.question: Are there per-order or transaction fees?
faq.answer: No. You pay the plan price only. Stripe's standard processing fees apply to payments in each store's Stripe account.

faq.question: Who pays the supplier and print cost, and when?
faq.answer: Shoppers pay the store at checkout. The production partner charges the store for supplier, print and shipping costs when the order goes into production. For marketplace suppliers such as Alibaba.com, you pay the supplier directly on their terms.

faq.question: Which currency am I billed in, and is VAT added?
faq.answer: Plans are billed in US dollars or euros, the currency shown when you sign up. Prices exclude tax. VAT or sales tax is added based on your billing country, and EU businesses with a valid VAT number are billed under the reverse charge.

faq.question: What happens to client stores if I downgrade?
faq.answer: Nothing is deleted. If you have more live stores than the new plan includes, archive the extra stores. Archived stores keep their products, orders and history, and you can restore them at any time.

terms.metaDescription: The terms covering agency workspaces, client stores, supplier orders and merchant-of-record responsibilities on Parcelith.
terms.title: Terms of service
terms.lead: These terms govern agency workspaces and the client stores operated inside them.

sections.heading: 1. The service
body: Parcelith provides a multi-store commerce workspace. An agency creates and operates stores on behalf of its clients. Each store is an isolated commerce channel with its own catalog, customers, orders, currencies, tax configuration, storefront and payment account.
Parcelith supplies the software, the shared supplier catalog and the routing between a paid order and a production partner. It does not manufacture goods, hold stock or take custody of shopper funds.

sections.heading: 2. Merchant of record
body: The seller operating each store is the merchant of record for that store. Payments settle into the store's own connected Stripe account. The seller is responsible for pricing, tax collection and remittance, refunds, chargebacks, consumer rights obligations and any liability arising from goods sold.

Tax brackets configured by the platform administrator are a convenience for calculating tax on a product. Selecting a bracket does not transfer any tax obligation to Parcelith or make Parcelith a party to the sale.

sections.heading: 3. Supplier orders
body: Production partners are independent third parties. Where a partner exposes an order submission API, paid orders may be routed automatically. Where no such API exists, including sourcing marketplaces such as Alibaba.com, the order is flagged for manual handling and the seller raises the purchase order directly with the supplier under that supplier's own terms.
Lead times, availability and fulfilment regions shown in the shared catalog are supplied by the partner and may change without notice. Parcelith does not warrant them.

sections.heading: 4. Artwork and intellectual property
body: You retain ownership of artwork you upload. You warrant that you hold the rights to reproduce it on physical goods, and you indemnify Parcelith and its production partners against claims arising from artwork you supply.

Pre-flight checks (print area bounds, effective resolution, file format, file size and transparency) are automated quality controls. Passing pre-flight is not an assessment of whether you are entitled to print the design.

sections.heading: 5. AI-generated suggestions
body: The commerce assistant produces drafts: product ideas, supplier recommendations, descriptions, tags and prices. Every suggestion is stored in a pending state and applied only after a named user confirms it. You remain responsible for the accuracy of any copy or price you choose to publish.

sections.heading: 6. Data isolation and access
body: Store data is scoped to the store. Agency staff reach a store either through agency ownership or through an explicit invitation with a role attached. Shopper records are never combined across stores, including in agency-level reporting.
Administrative actions, store setup changes, product imports, price changes, AI approvals, publishing actions and order routing are written to an audit history retained for the life of the workspace.

sections.heading: 7. Suspension and termination
body: Either party may end the agreement with 30 days' notice. Archiving a store keeps its records readable for reporting and audit but removes it from day-to-day operation and takes its storefront offline.
Parcelith may suspend a workspace that is used to infringe third-party rights or to sell goods prohibited by a production partner.

privacy.metaDescription: What Parcelith stores about agency staff, store teams and shoppers, why it is stored, and how store data is kept isolated.
privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: How data moves through an agency workspace, and where the boundary between stores sits.

sections.heading: Who controls what
body: For agency and store team accounts, Parcelith is the controller of the account record: name, work email, role and the actions attributed to that person in the audit history.

For shopper data (order contact details, delivery address, artwork uploaded at checkout and personalisation text), the store operating the sale is the controller. Parcelith processes that data on the store's instruction so the order can be produced and delivered.

sections.heading: What is stored
body: Account records: name, email, role, agency, and store memberships.
Store configuration: branding, currencies, domain, connected payment account identifier, carrier account numbers and tax settings. Payment credentials go directly to Stripe.
Commerce records: products, artwork files and their placement, generated mockups, orders, fulfilment events, tracking numbers and refunds.
Audit history: who changed what and when, across store setup, imports, pricing, AI approvals, publishing, order routing and administration.

sections.heading: How isolation works
body: Every commerce record carries the store it belongs to, and every read is scoped to a store the signed-in person has been granted access to. Agency-level reporting aggregates order totals per store; it never merges shopper identities between stores.
A shopper who buys from two stores operated by the same agency exists as two separate customer records, because the two stores are separate controllers.

sections.heading: Third parties
body: Stripe processes payments on behalf of each store under that store's own account.

Production partners (Printful, Gelato and Printify) receive the delivery address, the item specification and the artwork file needed to make and ship the order. Sourcing enquiries raised through Alibaba.com are made by the seller directly.
DHL, FedEx and UPS receive the delivery address to carry the parcel and return tracking events.
The commerce assistant sends product and catalog context to a third-party AI provider to draft suggestions. Shopper personal data is not included in those prompts.

sections.heading: Retention
body: Order and fulfilment records are retained for as long as the store operates plus the period the seller must keep them for tax purposes. Archiving a store keeps its records readable for audit and reporting but takes its storefront offline.
Artwork uploaded by a shopper is retained while the order can still be reproduced or disputed, then removed with the order record.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Team members can ask their agency administrator to correct or remove their account. Shoppers should contact the store they bought from. The store team can export or erase an order record and its artwork from the order screen.

storePolicies.refunds:
## Personalised and made-to-order items
Every item from {store} is made to order, and many carry your own name, text or artwork. Because they are made for you, we cannot accept returns or exchanges for a change of mind, or for a size or colour you chose. Please check your design, spelling and size before you place your order.

## Damaged, faulty or wrong items
If your order arrives damaged, faulty or different from what you ordered, contact us within 30 days of delivery with your order number and a photo. We will send a replacement or give you a full refund at no cost to you.

## Items without personalisation
Unused items without personalisation can be returned within 14 days of delivery. Contact us before sending anything back. Return shipping is paid by you unless the item is faulty.

## Cancellations
You can cancel free of charge until your order goes into production. Contact us as soon as possible with your order number.

## Refunds
Approved refunds go back to the original payment method within 10 business days.

## Your statutory rights
This policy does not affect your statutory rights as a consumer.
storePolicies.shipping:
## Production
Every item is made after you order. Production usually takes 2 to 5 business days. Large orders can take longer, and we will tell you if they do.

## Delivery
Once your order ships, delivery usually takes 3 to 7 business days depending on the destination. The total you pay, including any shipping, is shown at checkout before you pay.

## Tracking
You can follow your order at any time on the order status page with your order number and email address.

## Customs and import duties
Orders sent to another country may be charged import duties or taxes on arrival. These are not included in the price and are paid by the recipient.

## Delayed or lost parcels
If your parcel has not arrived 10 business days after it shipped, contact us with your order number and we will trace it with the carrier.

## Delivery address
Please check your delivery address before you pay. We cannot redirect an order once it has shipped.
storePolicies.terms:
## About these terms
These terms apply to every order placed with {store}. By placing an order you agree to them.

## Orders
Your order is confirmed once payment is accepted and you receive an order number. If we cannot fulfil an order, we will cancel it and refund you in full.

## Prices and payment
Prices are shown in the currency you choose, and tax is shown at checkout. Payment is taken when you place your order.

## Personalisation
You are responsible for the text and artwork you add to a product and confirm that you have the right to use it. We may cancel an order whose content is unlawful, offensive or infringes the rights of others. Printed colours can differ slightly from how they look on screen.

## Delivery, returns and refunds
Delivery is covered by our shipping policy. Returns and refunds are covered by our refund policy.

## Liability
Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law. Otherwise our liability for an order is limited to the amount you paid for it.

## Changes
We may update these terms. The terms shown when you placed your order apply to that order.
storePolicies.privacy:
## What we collect
When you order from {store}, we collect your name, email address, delivery address, phone number if you give one, the items you order and any text or artwork you add to them.

## How we use it
We use this information to make and deliver your order, to send you updates about it and to answer your questions. We do not sell your personal information.

## Payments
Card payments are processed by our payment provider. We do not store your full card number.

## Who we share it with
We share only what is needed with the partners who make and deliver your order, such as production partners and carriers.

## How long we keep it
We keep order records for as long as needed to complete your order and to meet our legal and accounting obligations.

## Your rights
You can ask to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you. Contact us from the email address you used to order.

## Cookies
This shop uses cookies to remember your basket, language and currency.
